name: Masterful Epic Tales
body:
You are quicker to scribe epic tales, and they are more effective, being easier to use and lasting longer.

Prerequisite(s): Profession (scribe) 10 ranks, 6th-level chronicler

Benefit: The epic tales that you scribe with your epic tales and Greater epic tales class abilities retain their supernatural potency twice as long as normal (2 days per class level) and require only 30 minutes to inscribe instead of an hour. Additionally, they require only a standard action to activate instead of a full-round action, and their duration is increased to 1 minute per 3 levels of chronicler you possess.

Normal: See the epic tales class feature.
